body:
This was around 2 years ago, a couple of mates n I went up to London to visit a mate and go to her flat. We spend the night burning spliffs and havin some drinks before deciding to try and get some k. One of my mates was passed out from drink but the other 3 of us were soberin up and ready 2 party. Unable to get k, I remembered in my bag I had 4 capsules of 4-HO-MET, n suggested to my mates we split it between the 3 of us. We opened up the capsules and emptied the powder onto a surface, n split it back into 3 wiv one of them getting a bigger dose as my other mates didnt wanna trip so hard. So, I took the largest amount. This was my second time doing it so felt like I knew what to expect, but this trip was pretty different to the last
this trip was pretty different to the last
, wayyyyy more psychological and headspacey, if that makes sense?
While we were waiting to come up my mate suggested we put on a movie. Scrolling thru nexflix we came across the 2003 cat in the hat movie and my mate begged we put it on, sayin she hadnt watched it but jus had a feelin it would be good.
Queue the most godforsaken cursed movie I have ever seen in my life. Perhaps it was the drugs  ok it was definitely the drugs lol  but we were fuckin enraptured by this movie. Time did not exist I couldnt tell u how long it felt, like the longest shortest thing ever, complete time distortion. I lost all perception of who I was, what was going on, I couldnt look away from the screen. It was the most wretched terrifying movie you could ever make a child watch, we couldnt BELIEVE it was made for kids and not teenagers on acid but jesus Christ. We were laughing hysterically but also crying uncontrollably? The overly cartoonish visuals that this gave me, coupled with the garish colours and animations of the movie was one hell of a ride. Not to mention the plot twist towards the end, in which reality doesnt even exist that had us screaming.
My poor mate whod passed out from drinkin was periodically waking up wondering what in the fuck was going on bless him, eventually realising we were no longer just drunk.
Effects wore off after about 4 hours, with the remainder of our trip spent trying to repiece together our lives and come to terms with wtf happened haha.
